blurb: Black Horse Golf offers a 9-hole golf course with yardages of 70-120 yards designed for new players, juniors, women, seniors, and experienced golfers to practice and improve their short game. The facility includes a driving range with grass and synthetic tees, a bunker area for short game practice, and a large synthetic putting green free of charge. FootGolf is also available on the 9-hole course, suitable for all ages and skill levels, played with a regulation size 5 soccer ball.
extraNote: Operate on honor system with payment via cash or Venmo · Respect worship services in clubhouse Sundays 9-12; limit range use to after 11:30am on Sundays
